name: AI Autocomplete
summary: Shopify search upgrade that suggests filters such as type, colour or brand as shoppers type, drawn from your own catalogue.
best_for: Shopify store owners with large catalogues who want filter suggestions to appear as shoppers type in the search box
skip_if: your catalogue is small, you want a fixed monthly price with no usage charge, or you want an app with a longer review history
honest_knock: Usage charges sit on top of the monthly fee and the listing does not define a prediction. The app launched on 2 September 2026, so there is little track record. Three of 11 reviews are one-star.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per monthly, Starter is $10 a month with 20,000 predictions and $0.0005 for each prediction beyond
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-13 on apps.shopify.com/ai-autocomplete, charges in USD billed every 30 days) AI Autocomplete has two plans, both with a 30-day free trial. Starter costs $10 a month plus usage and includes 20,000 predictions a month, then $0.0005 for each prediction beyond that. Standard costs $30 a month plus usage and includes 100,000 predictions a month, then $0.0003 for each prediction beyond that. The listing does not say what counts as one prediction, so we cannot tell how fast a busy store would use up the allowance. We did not install the app, so we do not know the real monthly bill on a live store.
